integrity: The symbolic argument handles all prime powers and distinguishes proof from finite tests; relevant exact-object earlier studies are explicitly credited. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ring Fq[x,y]/(x³,y³); no claim of general exponents, automorphism-orbit classification, or original large-characteristic partition support. title: The finite-field Jordan-type distribution of \(\mathbb F_q[x,y]/(x^3,y^3)\)
